ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with high-intensity (white) focal points; ratio estimated at 80:20 across visible regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive distribution of high-contrast white circular blobs and micro-mottling scattered across the primarily dark-pigmented surface of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an estimated interior pixel angle of 45-55 degrees and significant depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations and frequent jagged peaks, particularly prominent along the inner edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the outer margins of the lobes transitioning into a sharp inward taper toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (rosette patterns) widely distributed across the ventral surface, suggesting barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear scratches (rake marks) crossing the pigmentation mapping, most visible on the distal half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of barnacles and associated calcified trauma at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Solid white pigmentation patch at the lower right corner of the fluke where it meets the water line.
